title: Generals without clearance turned away at Cape Canaveral gate
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: So we would have people like three star generals that are on vacation in Florida drive up

plain: In the 1990s, according to a former NASA doctor named Greg Rogers, three-star generals on vacation in Florida would sometimes drive up to the gate at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station and get turned away because they did not have the right clearance. Rogers says he saw this himself, and he tells it to show how tightly the base guarded access.
